description: GS1 parsing corpus: each case is an input to our GS1 parsers with the result GS1's Barcode Syntax Engine gives for it. Valid cases list the (AI, value) elements in order; invalid ones must be rejected.

engine.name: GS1 Barcode Syntax Engine (https://github.com/gs1/gs1-syntax-engine), WebAssembly build
engine.settings: RequisiteAIs validation off (AI associations are judged over all carriers on an item, not per barcode); every other option at its default: MutexAIs, RepeatedAIs, DigSigSerialKey and UnknownAInotDLattr on, permitUnknownAIs, permitZeroSuppressedGTINinDLuris and addCheckDigit off

generated.sources: inputs of the engine's unit-test vectors (ai.c, dl.c, scandata.c), one valid element string per dictionary AI with input-form and broken variants, and hand-written cases (see the script)

kinds.scan: scan data with an AIM symbology identifier (]C1, ]e0, ]d2, ]Q3, ]J1 AI data; ]E0/]E4 EAN; ]Q1, ]d1, ]J0 plain data or a Digital Link URI); engine: scanData. EAN-13/EAN-8 primary data is listed as (01), padded to 14 digits
kinds.elementString: AI data without symbology identifier, GS (\u001d) as FNC1, optionally a leading GS; engine: dataStr "^" + data
kinds.bracketed: bracketed AI data, (AI)value, a literal "(" written "\("; engine: aiDataStr
kinds.digitalLink: a GS1 Digital Link URI; engine: dataStr
